article.story: MOON TOWNSHIP, Pa. -- — K.C. Ugwuakazi’s 20 points helped Robert Morris defeat Capital 94-45 on Sunday. Ugwuakazi added 10 rebounds for the Colonials (1-3). Jalik Dunkley scored 17 points while shooting 6 of 6 from the field and 5 for 6 from the line, and added seven rebounds. Will Occomy had 13 points and shot 5 for 6, including 3 for 3 from beyond the arc. Julian Mitchell led the way for the Crusaders with nine points. Up next Robert Morris visits Toledo in its next matchup on Thursday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
